en: Which cabin crew member is responsible for the safety of passengers?
uk: Який бортпровідник відповідає за безпеку пасажирів?
en_para: Who among the cabin staff looks after passenger safety on board?
evidence: Flight attendant is the crew member responsible for the safety of passengers.

en: Why do Delta Air Lines and American Airlines use LaGuardia Airport as a hub in New York City?
uk: Чому Delta Air Lines та American Airlines використовують аеропорт Ла-Гуардія як хаб у Нью-Йорку?
en_para: What explains the use of LaGuardia as a domestic hub in New York by Delta and American?
evidence: Delta Air Lines' and American Airlines' uses of LaGuardia Airport as a domestic hub in New York City, due to capacity and slot restrictions at their hubs at John F. Kennedy International Airport.

en: Which organization defines the four-letter ICAO airport codes?
uk: Яка організація визначає чотирилітерні коди аеропортів ICAO?
en_para: Which body sets the four-letter airport identifiers known as ICAO codes?
evidence: These codes are defined by the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) and published quarterly in ICAO Document 7910: Location Indicators.

en: Which kinds of companies commonly use non-refundable reservations to limit overbooking?
uk: Які типи компаній зазвичай використовують бронювання без повернення коштів для обмеження овербукінгу?
en_para: What types of carriers typically sell non-refundable tickets so that fewer seats need to be oversold?
evidence: This can be done by making reservations non-refundable, a common practice among low-cost carriers and railways

en: Who originally designed and operated computer reservation systems?
uk: Хто розробив та спочатку керував комп'ютерними системами бронювання?
en_para: Which parties first built and ran computerized reservation systems?
evidence: Originally designed and operated by airlines, CRSs were later extended for use by travel agencies

en: How do budget airlines compensate for the revenue lost due to lower ticket prices?
uk: Як бюджетні авіакомпанії компенсують втрату доходу через нижчі ціни на квитки?
en_para: How do low-fare carriers make up for earning less per ticket?
evidence: To make up for revenue lost in decreased ticket prices, the airline may charge extra fees, such as for carry-on baggage.

en: How does mid-office travel automation help travel agencies handle reservation accuracy and ticketing?
uk: Як автоматизація середнього офісу (mid-office) допомагає туристичним агенціям забезпечувати точність бронювання та виписку квитків?
en_para: In what way does mid-office automation help agencies check that bookings are correct and handle ticket issuing?
evidence: lets travel agencies create custom business rules to validate reservation accuracy, monitor travel policies, perform file finishing, prepare itineraries/invoices and process ticketing.

en: What is the average flight duration handled by the Maastricht Upper Area Control Centre?
uk: Яка середня тривалість польоту, що обслуговується Маастрихтським центром управління верхнім повітряним рухом?
en_para: How long, on average, are the flights managed by the Maastricht upper airspace control centre?
evidence: The average flight duration is approximately 21 minutes

en: What do IATA airport codes designate?
uk: Що позначають коди аеропортів IATA?
en_para: What does an IATA airport code identify?
evidence: is a unique three-letter geocode designating many airports, cities (with one or more airports) and metropolitan areas (cities with more than one airport) around the world

en: Which airline engineers are responsible for certifying aircraft for flight and managing aircraft maintenance?
uk: Які авіаційні інженери відповідають за сертифікацію повітряних суден для польотів та управління технічним обслуговуванням?
en_para: Which engineers at airlines sign off aircraft as fit to fly and oversee maintenance?
evidence: Groundcrew, responsible for operations at airports, include Aerospace and avionics engineers responsible for certifying the aircraft for flight and management of aircraft maintenance

en: By what percentage are net carbon emissions from air transport targeted to decrease by 2050 compared to 2005 levels?
uk: На який відсоток планується зменшити чисті викиди вуглекислого газу від повітряного транспорту до 2050 року порівняно з рівнем 2005 року?
en_para: What is the 2050 target for cutting net aviation CO2 emissions versus the 2005 baseline?
evidence: A 50% reduction in net aviation carbon emissions by 2050 relative to 2005 levels.

en: What kind of models do quantity-based forecasts rely on in revenue management?
uk: На які моделі спираються кількісні прогнози в управлінні доходами?
en_para: Which forecasting models underpin quantity-based demand forecasts in revenue management?
evidence: Quantity-based forecasts, which use time-series models, booking curves, cancellation curves, etc., project future quantities of demand, such as reservations or products bought.

en: What is the typical duration of an aircraft dry lease?
uk: Яка типова тривалість сухого лізингу повітряного судна?
en_para: How long does a standard dry lease of an aircraft usually run?
evidence: A typical dry lease lasts upwards of two years

en: When did European regulation first mandate security screenings for domestic passenger flights?
uk: Коли європейське законодавство вперше зобов'язало проводити перевірки безпеки на внутрішніх пасажирських рейсах?
en_para: In which year did EU rules first require security checks on domestic passenger flights?
evidence: The regulation no 2320/2002 from 2002 introduced the requirement to have security checks for all passenger flights, also domestic.

en: Does the Chicago Convention prohibit taxation on aviation fuel used for domestic flights?
uk: Чи забороняє Чиказька конвенція оподаткування авіаційного палива, що використовується на внутрішніх рейсах?
en_para: Can a country tax kerosene for domestic flights under the Chicago Convention?
evidence: The Chicago Convention does not preclude a kerosene tax on domestic flights and on refueling before international flights.

en: Are helicopter flights covered under the air passengers rights regulation?
uk: Чи поширюються правила щодо прав авіапасажирів на польоти гелікоптерів?
en_para: Do passenger rights rules cover flights operated by helicopters?
evidence: It does not apply to helicopter flights, to any flight not operated by a fixed-wing aircraft, nor to flights from Gibraltar Airport.

en: What is the typical passenger capacity for regional airliners?
uk: Яка типова пасажиромісткість регіональних літаків?
en_para: How many people can a regional airliner usually carry?
evidence: Regional airliners typically seat fewer than 100 passengers and may be powered by turbofans or turboprops.

en: What tasks are involved in aircraft provisioning during ground handling?
uk: Які завдання включає забезпечення повітряного судна під час наземного обслуговування?
en_para: During turnaround, which jobs count as provisioning an aircraft?
evidence: Provisioning – replacing literature, blankets, pillows, and consumable supplies.

en: What is an alternative name for a maintenance release in air transport?
uk: Яка альтернативна назва дозволу на випуск в експлуатацію в повітряному транспорті?
en_para: What else is a maintenance release called?
evidence: A maintenance release is sometimes called a certificate of release to service (CRS).

en: According to a USA Today analysis, what is the top cause of flight delays?
uk: Згідно з аналізом USA Today, яка головна причина затримки рейсів?
en_para: What does a USA Today analysis name as the leading reason for flight delays?
evidence: Airline glitches. The top cause of flight delays, according to a USA Today analysis.

en: IATA Resolution 763 airport codes
uk: Резолюція IATA 763 коди аеропортів
en_para: Which IATA resolution governs how airport codes are assigned?
evidence: The assignment of these codes is governed by IATA Resolution 763, and it is administered by the IATA's headquarters in Montreal, Canada.

en: aircraft cabin cleaning services
uk: послуги прибирання салону літака
en_para: What cleaning services are carried out inside an aircraft cabin?
evidence: Cabin cleaning – cleaning seats, galleys, and lavatories.

en: legacy carriers US airline deregulation act
uk: традиційні авіаперевізники закон США про дерегуляцію авіакомпаній
en_para: Which airlines are called legacy carriers in relation to the US Airline Deregulation Act?
evidence: Legacy carriers, US carriers that predate the Airline Deregulation Act of 1978.

en: IATA aviation carbon neutral growth strategy
uk: стратегія IATA вуглецево нейтрального зростання авіації
en_para: What carbon-neutral growth goal did IATA members adopt for aviation?
evidence: At the 2013 IATA annual general meeting in Cape Town, South Africa, members overwhelmingly endorsed a resolution on "Implementation of the Aviation Carbon-Neutral Growth (CNG2020) Strategy."

en: central reservation systems CRS air travel
uk: центральні системи бронювання CRS авіаперевезення
en_para: What is a central reservation system in air travel?
evidence: Computer reservation systems, or central reservation systems (CRS), are computerized systems used to store and retrieve information and conduct transactions related to air travel, hotels, car rental, or other activities.

en: Thai Airways Flight 679 runway excursion
uk: рейс 679 Thai Airways виїзд за межі злітно-посадкової смуги
en_para: What does a runway excursion mean, as in the Thai Airways 679 incident?
evidence: Runway excursion – an incident involving only a single aircraft, where it makes an inappropriate exit from the runway (e.g. Thai Airways Flight 679).

en: Air France Flight 447 CRM failure
uk: рейс 447 Air France помилка CRM
en_para: Did poor crew resource management contribute to the Air France 447 accident?
evidence: One analysis blames failure to follow proper CRM procedures as being a contributing factor that led to the 2009 fatal crash into the Atlantic Ocean of Air France Flight 447 from Rio de Janeiro to Paris.

en: Paris Convention of 1919 ICAN
uk: Паризька конвенція 1919 року ICAN
en_para: What did the 1919 Paris Convention establish as a forerunner of ICAO?
evidence: Following this, at the Paris Convention of 1919, a forerunner to ICAO named ICAN was established, the International Commission for Air Navigation.

en: preighter passenger aircraft cargo
uk: пасажирський літак у вантажному режимі preighter
en_para: How can a passenger plane be turned into a cargo carrier, a so-called preighter?
evidence: A passenger aircraft can also be used as a preighter in which the entire passenger cabin is temporarily dedicated to carrying freight.

en: How is the flight distance used for compensation determined under the Air Passengers Rights Regulation, and which kind of seismic events are given as examples of causes of flight disruption?
uk: Як визначається відстань рейсу для компенсації за регламентом про права авіапасажирів, і які сейсмічні явища наведено як приклади причин зриву рейсів?
en_para: What determines the flight distance used to calculate compensation under the passenger rights regulation, and which earthquake-type events are cited as causes of disruption?
evidence: The requirements for an entitlement to compensation and the specific amount owed depend on the length of a flight, whereas the relevant distance is determined according to the great circle method.
Earthquakes and tsunamis (e.g., in the event of 2004 Indian Ocean earthquake and tsunami, 2010 Chile earthquake, and the 2011 Tōhoku earthquake and tsunami)

en: How do low-cost carriers discourage unused reservations as an alternative to overbooking, and what type of forecasts use cancellation curves to project future demand quantities?
uk: Як лоукост-перевізники стримують невикористані бронювання як альтернативу овербукінгу, і який тип прогнозів використовує криві скасувань для оцінки майбутнього попиту?
en_para: What do low-cost airlines do to cut down on no-shows instead of overbooking, and which forecast type projects demand using cancellation curves?
evidence: This can be done by making reservations non-refundable, a common practice among low-cost carriers and railways, or requiring customers wishing to cancel their right to a service to pay a termination fee.
Quantity-based forecasts, which use time-series models, booking curves, cancellation curves, etc., project future quantities of demand, such as reservations or products bought.

en: Where is the IATA headquarters that administers airport code assignments, and in what city was the 2013 annual general meeting held where members endorsed the Aviation Carbon-Neutral Growth strategy?
uk: Де розташована штаб-квартира IATA, що адмініструє призначення кодів аеропортів, і в якому місті відбулися загальні збори 2013 року, де члени підтримали стратегію вуглецево нейтрального зростання авіації?
en_para: Where is IATA headquartered as the administrator of airport codes, and where was the 2013 general meeting that backed carbon-neutral growth?
evidence: At the 2013 IATA annual general meeting in Cape Town, South Africa, members overwhelmingly endorsed a resolution on "Implementation of the Aviation Carbon-Neutral Growth (CNG2020) Strategy."
The assignment of these codes is governed by IATA Resolution 763, and it is administered by the IATA's headquarters in Montreal, Canada.

en: Which organization defines ICAO airport codes, and what is the IATA airport code for Cairo, Egypt?
uk: Яка організація визначає коди аеропортів ICAO і який код IATA має аеропорт Каїра (Єгипет)?
en_para: Who defines ICAO airport codes, and what is the three-letter IATA code for Cairo?
evidence: These codes are defined by the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) and published quarterly in ICAO Document 7910: Location Indicators.
CAI – Cairo, Egypt
